response.description: Advanced capacity insights are now available for preview in Azure Storage Discovery. Storage Discovery now provides greater visibility into storage usage through insights such as access patterns, data age, storage tiers, object size distribution, retention states, and versioning. With these insights, teams can identify opportunities, understand factors contributing to storage growth, and inform storage management decisions at scale.Learn more:Discover what's new with advanced capacity insightsExplore advanced capacity insights and capabilitiesGet started with Azure Storage Discovery
response.title: Public Preview: Advanced capacity insights are now available in Azure Storage Discovery
